senses.gloss: (v. מִדָּה, מְכַילְתָּא) system of laws, treatise, tract.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 10:3:12">Y. Shebi. X, end, 39ᵈ</cite> <he>בר נש דתני חדא מ׳ וב׳</he> a man that has studied one tract and comes to a place where they honor him for two tracts, is bound to tell them <he>אנא חדא מ׳ אנא חכם</he> I know only one tract; Y. Macc. II, end, 32ᵃ.—Pl. <cite ref="M01154"><he>מֵיכְלָן</he></cite>.
Targ. Y. Num. XIII, 33, מ׳ בישין bad manners (cmp. מִדָּה).—Y. Macc. l. c. תרין מ׳ (not מיכלה).
